summary: Very steep residential kerb, 12% average, with homes 11-12 m away.

best_section.where: East kerb of Brisbane Street, just up from the Carmody Road corner, beside the unit block

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 11 m at the start, then houses 12 m away along the whole east side. Nothing secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked-car lane on the east kerb, so room to pull in, but the road is steep.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, but 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 13% at best section, 21% max
Gate 229 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Street trees on the east verge shade the kerb from the east; open to the afternoon sun.
